label: PF Backlog 221
title: Backend: multi-modal end-to-end acceptance test (one golden path per modality)
body:
## Problem / why
We are adding kinds, adapters, packs, and models with no single e2e proof that a media/sensor project
runs start-to-finish. Unit tests will not catch integration gaps across router+adapter+store+QA.

## Goal & value
A hermetic (fake-adapter) e2e test that proves each modality's happy path through the real pipeline
control flow, plus one optional live smoke behind a flag.

## In scope
- Fake adapters for each kind: image-gen, video-gen(async), tts, stt, music-gen(async), 3d-gen(async),
  ocr, embedding, timeseries/sensor -- returning deterministic fixtures (tiny files).
- For each modality: idea -> capability gate -> pack enable -> model strategy -> router -> adapter ->
  asset store -> media QA -> artifact assertions.
- Assertions: artifact exists + type, QA passes, cost booked with correct billing_unit, text-only
  project path unchanged (regression guard).
- Optional live smoke (`PF_E2E_LIVE=1`) hitting free-tier/self-host for one image + one audio.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- One test per modality, all green with fakes, no network; suite stays fast (<30s).
- A text-only project produces no media artifacts and no media cost.
- Async path (submit->poll->fetch) exercised for video/music/3d.

## Verification / test plan
- Run in CI; wired_audit + compileall green. Live smoke documented, non-blocking.
